See also: Ernst

Dutch

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Middle Dutch ernst, from Old Dutch ernost, from Proto-Germanic *ernustuz.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɛrnst/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Hyphenation: ernst

Noun

[edit]

ernst m (uncountable, no diminutive)

  1. seriousness
    Synonyms: serieusheid, seriositeit
  2. (obsolete) earnestness, industriousness
    Synonyms: ijver, vlijt

Derived terms

[edit]
  • ernstig
  • ernstvuurwerk

Descendants

[edit]
  • Afrikaans: erns
  • Negerhollands: ernst

Anagrams

[edit]
  • nerts, snert

German

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

    From Middle High German ërnst, from Old High German ernust, from Proto-West Germanic *ernust, from Proto-Germanic *ernustuz, whence also English earnest.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /ɛʁnst/
    • Audio (Germany):(file)
    • Audio (Austria):(file)
    • Audio (Germany (Berlin)):(file)

    Adjective

    [edit]

    ernst (strong nominative masculine singular ernster, comparative ernster, superlative am ernstesten)

    1. serious, severe, grave

    Middle Dutch

    [edit]

    Alternative forms

    [edit]
    • ernest

    Etymology

    [edit]

    From Old Dutch ernost, from Proto-Germanic *ernustuz.

    Noun

    [edit]

    ernst m

    1. combativeness
    2. eagerness, zeal
    3. seriousness

    Inflection

    [edit]
    Strong masculine noun
    singular plural
    nominative ernst ernste
    accusative ernst ernste
    genitive ernsts ernste
    dative ernste ernsten

    Descendants

    [edit]
    • Dutch: ernst
      • Afrikaans: erns
      • Negerhollands: ernst
    • Limburgish: èrns

    [edit]

    Slovincian

    [edit]

    Etymology

    [edit]
    Etymology tree
    Proto-Indo-European *Her-der.
    Proto-Germanic *arnizder.
    Proto-Germanic *ernustuz
    Old High German ernust
    Middle High German ërnst
    German ernstbor.
    Slovincian ernst

      Borrowed from German ernst.

      Pronunciation

      [edit]
      • IPA(key): /ˈɛrnst/
      • Rhymes: -ɛrnst
      • Syllabification: ernst

      Adjective

      [edit]

      ernst (not comparable, indeclinable, no derived adverb)

      1. serious

      Adverb

      [edit]

      ernst (not comparable)

      1. seriously
